# TICKET-RT-085 — M1 Live-Like Loss Forensics & M15 Degradation Attribution

## Scope and baseline gate

Audit/research only on branch `back-up`, base commit `1fd96a768587438804c5d1b9c50f543ed2b1198f`. Production signal, entry, SL, TP, sizing, risk logic, configuration, thresholds and filters were not changed.

| Group | Trades | WR | Gross PF | Net PF | Expectancy R | Net R |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| RT-084 main realistic baseline | 4919 | 34.2% | 1.089 | 0.936 | -0.047 | -229.0 |

Baseline gate: **PASS** — candidates 7,133, filled 4,919, wins 1,680, losses 3,239, WR 34.2%, Gross PF 1.089, Net PF 0.936, Net Exp -0.047R, Net R -229.0R.

## Measurement definitions

- Timestamps are UTC ISO-8601. Entry timestamp is the open time of the M1 fill candle; exit timestamp is the close boundary of the terminal M1 candle. Consequently a terminal event in the fill candle has holding duration 1 M1.
- Pending duration is `(entry timestamp - decision timestamp) / 1 minute`. Holding duration and minutes-to-SL/TP are both `(exit timestamp - entry timestamp) / 1 minute`; both requested columns are retained in the trade appendix.
- MAE/MFE are directed R excursions strictly before the terminal M1, using M1 OHLC for partial fill/exit M15 blocks and the identical frozen M15 extremes for complete intermediate blocks. The terminal M1 is excluded because M1 OHLC cannot establish whether its favorable/adverse extreme occurred before or after SL/TP. Same-M1 exits therefore have MAE=0R and MFE=0R under this auditable lower-bound definition.
- Per-trade H1 distance is signed `(latest closed H1 close - incremental EMA200) / EMA200`; breakdown buckets use its absolute value. FVG width is `(gapHigh-gapLow)/entry`; SL distance is `abs(entry-SL)/entry`.
- Bucket boundaries were fixed before reading grouped results. Empty groups remain visible.

## M15 degradation attribution

The labels requested by the ticket mix transitions (winner→loser) with causal probes (fill-candle and ambiguity), so counts below are intentionally non-additive. A separate Net-R transition decomposition is additive.

| Diagnostic | Trades | Definition |
|---|---:|---|
| M15 assumed fill, M1 did not fill | 983 | Conventional has an entry; M1 live-like has none |
| M15 winner → M1 loser | 347 | Both close, terminal outcomes flip |
| M15 loser → M1 winner | 15 | Both close, terminal outcomes flip |
| Fill-candle path/outcome | 61 | M1 outcome changes when exits in its fill M15 are skipped |
| Same-M1 SL+TP ambiguity | 10 | First terminal M1 touches both SL and TP |
| Pending expiry label difference | 0 | Both unfilled but EXPIRED/NOT_FILLED labels differ |
| Both filled, M1 fill occurs in a later M15 | 2397 | Fill timing changes even when both methods eventually fill |
| Other changed candidates | 0 | Changed fill/terminal status not covered by any diagnostic above |

### Why conventional filled when M1 did not

| Mechanical observation at conventional fill M15 | Trades |
|---|---:|
| Candle intersects gap but never reaches entry | 963 |
| Reaches entry but not 1bp trade-through | 20 |
| Reaches 1bp trade-through but M1 arming/recross does not produce a fill | 0 |
| Total | 983 |

### Additive Net-R transition attribution

| Transition | Live-like minus conventional Net R |
|---|---:|
| Same terminal status | -39.3R |
| M15 winner -> M1 loser | -1080.8R |
| M15 filled -> M1 not filled | -1810.1R |
| M15 loser -> M1 winner | 46.5R |
| Total | -2883.7R |

### Fill-candle omission counterfactual

| Group | Trades | WR | Gross PF | Net PF | Expectancy R | Net R |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| M15 conventional | 5902 | 49.9% | 2.089 | 1.819 | 0.450 | 2654.7 |
| M1 live-like baseline | 4919 | 34.2% | 1.089 | 0.936 | -0.047 | -229.0 |
| M1 fills, but skip entire fill M15 for exits | 4919 | 34.8% | 1.120 | 0.963 | -0.027 | -132.4 |

| Baseline outcome -> skip-fill-M15 outcome | Trades |
|---|---:|
| LOSS -> WIN | 46 |
| WIN -> LOSS | 15 |

Skipping the fill M15 while holding M1 fill eligibility fixed changes Net PF by +0.027, WR by +0.6 pp and Net R by 96.6R. Relative to the full conventional-to-live-like gap, those deltas equal 3.0% of the Net-PF gap and 4.0% of the WR gap. PF and WR are nonlinear ratios, so these percentages are counterfactual gap shares, not an additive causal decomposition.

Within the 347 conventional-winner→M1-loser transitions, 28 change under the skip-fill-M15 counterfactual and 2 are same-M1 SL+TP ambiguous. These are overlapping diagnostics, not additive causes.

## Audit provenance, verification and limitations

- Commands: `npm run audit:trend-live-like`; `npm run build:scripts`; `node apps/bot/scripts-dist/scripts/research/rt085M1LossForensics.js`; `npm test --workspace apps/bot -- trendLiveLikeExecution.test.ts`; `npm run typecheck`.
- Evidence: `apps/bot/scripts/research/rt085M1LossForensics.ts` and `TICKET-RT-085-m1-loss-forensics.md`. The report contains all 4,919 forensic rows; no separate hidden dataset is required.
- Deviations from ticket: none. No threshold, filter, configuration, signal, execution, sizing or risk behavior was changed. Code comments added/modified: 0 lines.
- The frozen replay retains the two RT-084 M1-to-M15 re-aggregation mismatches. M1 OHLC cannot identify tick order, queue priority, partial fills or the intraminute order of non-terminal extremes. PF/WR counterfactual shares are non-additive ratios; only the Net-R transition table is additive.
- No commit, push, merge, deploy or live trading/order API call occurred.
